title: Megha Health Insurance Scheme (MHIS) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Meghalaya government health insurance programme supporting eligible residents for hospitalization and specified treatments.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility is based on Meghalaya residency and current scheme enrolment/beneficiary rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Megha Health Insurance Scheme (MHIS).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
